lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Shields are dropping. No, they're being dropped, from the inside!

lines.speaker: weave
lines.text: [partial translation] CELL. YOU ARE ALREADY PART.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: The helm's locked. I have no helm!

lines.speaker: tern_pilot
lines.text: It's the seam. The seam is glowing red, all the way down!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Ashfall's prototype. Oh no. Oh no, no. I put it on us. I put it on us myself.

lines.speaker: tern_pilot
lines.text: We're moving. Captain, we're moving toward it.
